name: Disciple
overview: Scripture presents a disciple as one who is called and empowered by Jesus, as seen when He called the twelve disciples and gave them authority over unclean spirits and sickness (Matthew 10:1). Discipleship involves commitment and sacrifice, exemplified by Jesus’ teaching that one must forsake all possessions to truly follow Him (Luke 14:33). The mission of disciples includes making more disciples of all nations through teaching and baptism (Matthew 28:19), and this commission extends beyond the twelve to the seventy sent out in pairs to prepare the way for Jesus (Luke 10:1). The term 'disciple' also applies broadly, including followers of John the Baptist (Matthew 9:14), highlighting the distinctive identity and purpose of those who follow Christ.
